scientific limitations/integrity: The scalar equality Z(Cr_n)=2n-4 is prior work via Cr_n isomorphic to P_2 x K_n and Benson et al. (2018), Theorem 2.4. The retained claim is only the complete minimum-set classification and exact count. The proof is direct for all n>=3; finite exhaustive computation through n=9 is corroborative, not a substitute for proof. Literature comparison included crown, matching-deleted biclique, tensor-product, and bipartite-double-cover aliases.
title: Minimum zero forcing sets of crown graphs
